SUMMARY: I build the frontend of a children's fashion company: the applications its shops and its wholesale clients use every day, and the internal tools that hold them up. Mostly React and TypeScript, some Angular, PHP and MySQL, all of it used by people who did not get to choose their software. I care about code that still reads well two years later, and about interfaces that ask nobody to learn something new to do their job.

CAREER_MAYORAL_DETAIL:
Ongoing development across eCommerce, B2B and back-office projects.

Since 2025: analyst and code reviewer on the back-office projects, keeping the code maintainable and the practices sound; and frontend developer on a B2B project, designing and implementing the interface and building the core application logic.
CAREER_PYMES_DETAIL: Ongoing development across several projects, with JavaScript (ES6), object-oriented PHP, CodeIgniter, Gulp, jQuery and CSS (Bootstrap, Grid, Flexbox). MySQL databases and end-to-end testing with Cypress.

TESTIMONIAL_JESUS_CORTES_TEXT:
I was lucky enough to work with Miguel for almost four years, and I can only speak well of him, professionally and personally.

He is a very versatile frontend developer, with a real capacity to adapt to different challenges and always a constructive attitude when it comes to finding solutions. Beyond the technical side — where it is worth stressing that he can pivot between wildly different teams and technologies — what stands out about Miguel is how he works with others: he is one of those people it is a pleasure to work with, always ready to help and to bring a good atmosphere to the team.

After all this time working together, I can say that as well as a great professional, I also come away with a friend. Any team will gain a great deal by having him.
